latest_release.name: Auto Dark Mode 11.1.1
latest_release.body:
**This is a hotfix release for Auto Dark Mode 11.1.0.** 

A huge thank you to our incredible community for spotting and reporting these issues so quickly!

Did you miss our massive 11.1 update? Discover all the exciting new features in the [full changelog here](https://github.com/AutoDarkMode/Windows-Auto-Night-Mode/releases/tag/11.1.0.23).

# Download
| Download link | sha256 hash |
| - | - |
| [Installer for Windows x86 and x64 (recommended for most machines)](https://github.com/AutoDarkMode/Windows-Auto-Night-Mode/releases/download/11.1.1.1/AutoDarkMode_Setup_11.1.1.1_x86.exe) | 89BCC3D49F87A5F7DFD245FA366EA426039111FED7E3DE44B5CBFC1C2871508A|
| [Installer for Windows ARM64 (recommended for Qualcomm based notebooks or tablets)](https://github.com/AutoDarkMode/Windows-Auto-Night-Mode/releases/download/11.1.1.1/AutoDarkMode_Setup_11.1.1.1_ARM64.exe) | 9369A9F710889FB9C4954354F35976536038F5AD6FED4A3C8D92BD3A258D72D3|

# Changelog (11.1.1.1)

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/AutoDarkMode/Windows-Auto-Night-Mode/compare/11.1.0.23...11.1.1.1

## Fixes
- Italian language was accidentally mixed up with Chinese (resolves #1249 by @Spiritreader).
- Under some circumstances Auto Dark Mode didn't save the window size nor the selected language after closing the app window (fixed by @Spiritreader).
- Fixed a bug where the Navigation View Header got cut off (in #1248 by @ChenYiLins).
- Many updates to the translations.

## Known Issues
- The process list on the condition page isn't filtering processes while typing (tracked in #1105).

## Known limitations
Auto Dark Mode comes with a few limitations, either due to Windows or because of technical reasons. 
You can find the full list here: [List of known limitations](https://github.com/AutoDarkMode/Windows-Auto-Night-Mode/wiki/Known-limitations)
